availability_audit: Chronology anchor: Route 113/114 is reached after Mauville/Wattson (cap 30) via Route 111 -> Route 112 -> Fiery Path, per Game Book C20/C21. Every member below is in work/reference-pools/pool-36.json with gate <= 36 and a source_detail map the player has already passed on the way to Route 113/114: Seaspray Cave B1F (Sneasel), Rusturf Tunnel (Drilbur), Petalburg City Old Rod (Magikarp), Route 102 (Togepi), Mauville Game Corner (Litten), Granite Cave 1F (Abra). No Route 118+, Mt. Pyre, desert-interior or post-Flannery sources are used. Mega Ring earned from Steven after Brawly (C13); Gyaradosite stone window 20. Route 114 is reached from Fallarbor per Game Book C20/C21. Adds NewMauville_Entrance (Magnezone gate 30).
plan: Steve is a Dragon/Rock setup team: Turtonator turns Iron Defense into Body Press, Alolan Graveler's Galvanize turns Double-Edge into an Electric move, Mold Breaker Fraxure spreads Breaking Swipe, and a Choice Scarf Rock Head Tyrantrum throws recoil-free Head Smash. Ground is the single best type on the board - 4x into Rock/Electric Graveler, 2x into Turtonator and Tyrantrum - so Excadrill leads beside Togekiss, which is immune to Earthquake and can therefore let it fire every turn. Togekiss carries Dazzling Gleam rather than Air Slash for this fight because Fairy is 2x into three of the four members. Mega Gyarados is the ace: Waterfall is 2x into Turtonator, Graveler and Tyrantrum, and Mega Gyarados's Water/Dark typing drops the base form's 4x Electric weakness to 2x, which matters against a Galvanize Double-Edge. Incineroar's Knock Off removes the two Eviolites and the Choice Scarf.
